cases.customer_question: Can Bluetooth qualification registration questions and Japanese radio certification (技適 / TELEC) questions be reviewed in advance before the customer meeting?
question_variants: Can you review our Bluetooth certification QA sheet before the meeting?
Can Bluetooth SIG and TELEC questions be answered ahead of the web meeting?
Can we discuss 技適 requirements together with Bluetooth qualification?
Should qualification questions be shared before the certification meeting?
Can the consultant prepare responses before the Bluetooth certification discussion?
cases.actual_issue: Managing pre-sales Bluetooth qualification consulting when the customer also requests support for Japanese radio certification requirements, including the need for advance technical preparation and expectation management.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The customer prepared a list of Bluetooth certification questions and later added questions about Japanese radio certification. The consulting team reviewed the questions internally before the meeting so they could provide organized answers during the discussion. The thread also highlights that supporting inexperienced customers on TELEC and radio-law topics can require significantly more effort than normal Bluetooth qualification consulting.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant instructed the sales contact to collect and distribute the customer's Bluetooth qualification and 技適 questions before the scheduled meeting so technical answers could be prepared in advance. Internal guidance emphasized that TELEC certification projects can create substantial support overhead when the customer has limited familiarity with regulatory certification terminology and processes. The consultant also advised proactively sending prepared responses to the customer before the web meeting to improve efficiency and clarity.
cases.decision_logic: Advance review of Bluetooth qualification and radio certification questions reduces meeting confusion, improves technical accuracy, and helps consultants estimate the support burden required for projects involving both Bluetooth SIG qualification and regional radio approvals such as TELEC.
cases.final_recommendation: Request customer qualification and radio certification questions before meetings, prepare written answers internally in advance, and align customer expectations regarding the complexity and support effort required for Bluetooth SIG qualification and TELEC certification activities.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: If Bluetooth qualification and TELEC discussions are handled without preparation, consultants may underestimate support effort, create customer confusion about certification scope, or spend excessive time clarifying basic regulatory concepts during the project. The thread explicitly notes that TELEC handling can generate significantly more work than standard Bluetooth logo qualification while providing limited project margin.
